title: C SAN address binding validator
description: Implement the C leaf-certificate SAN binding checks from R-X509-016/018/051 using existing DER helpers: require exactly one native 0200::/8 iPAddress equal to upstream AddrForKey(subject SPKI), reject zero/multiple/mismatch and forbidden names, ignore non-native iPAddress entries, and enforce SAN criticality iff subject is empty. Add an independent host test with pinned fixtures.
